|quote=The NGO Human Rights Watch regards criminalising drug use as “an infringement of fundamental human rights” and calls for the decriminalisation of all drug consumption.
Prohibition appears to serve as a means of social control.
These social developments are part of a redefinition of what belongs to the private sphere and personal preference, as opposed to what concerns the public sphere. They encompass religious beliefs, sexual preferences and many other life choices. We should remember that divorce was once impossible and later regulated, or that homosexuality was once a crime; abortion was also a serious criminal offence tried in the assize courts.
